answer: Voting power is locked to collateral, not headcount: each identity must lock 1,000 POA for 90 days to earn one vote, so splitting one deposit across 1,000 clones buys no extra influence, like an opal split into shards, each fragment worthless alone. An attacker wanting 1,000 votes must immobilize 1,000,000 POA. Any island of accounts sharing one funding wallet is frozen when over 40% of its votes trace to the same source, and the island stake is slashed 100%. A 150-agent canyon ring was caught: 132 votes funded from four wallets, all four deposits burned.
